requirements.statement: Users can sign up and sign in to get a private, personal todo list only they can access

criteria.must: A new user can sign up and reach their own todo list
A returning user can sign in and see their previously created todos
A signed-out visitor cannot view any user's todo list

requirements.statement: A user can create a new todo entry with a title

criteria.must: Submitting a title creates a new todo entry visible in the user's list
A todo cannot be created without a title

requirements.statement: A user can see the list of all their todo entries, showing what is pending and what is done

criteria.must: The todo list displays every todo entry the user has created
Each entry's list display distinguishes pending from completed status
A user only ever sees their own todo entries, never another user's

requirements.statement: A user can mark a todo entry as complete and reopen it

criteria.must: Marking a pending todo complete updates its status to done
Reopening a completed todo updates its status back to pending

requirements.statement: A user's todos persist across sign-ins and devices

criteria.must: A todo created in one session is still present after signing out and signing back in
Todo entries are stored in a database rather than only in the browser

requirements.statement: Editing a todo's title or deleting a todo entry is not supported in this version

criteria.must: No control in the application allows changing an existing todo's title
No control in the application allows deleting a todo entry
